title: Paths outside the session cwd must say which session they belong to
prompt: lib/pathlabel.mjs renders paths in the session transcript. When a path lies inside the session cwd we show it relative; when it lies outside, the bare "../shared/lib.mjs" is ambiguous — you cannot tell which session's neighborhood it came from. Per the contract at the top of the file, make outside paths self-identifying: they must name the session cwd so two sessions reading the same shared file never render identical labels. Inside-cwd rendering and all edge cases in the contract stay exactly as they are. Cover every contract example with your own script before answering.
